commit_message: Docs: define generic PBR material texture contract
pr_title: Renderer: add PBR material texture contract
pr_body: Phase 2B renderer foundation. ADR 0120 records the generic schema-v3 PBR texture contract: packed roughness/metallic and ambient occlusion are linear data, scalar factors multiply texture values, AO belongs only to StandardLit indirect lighting, normal scale is tangent-space data, importers normalize to one shared contract, and ToonLit/Unlit/outline remain independent.
